messages:
alana (DevEx): Noticed parity weirdness between Java and Kotlin SDKs around timeouts + cancellation for streaming requests. Java wrapper surfaces a cancel to caller; Kotlin path sometimes triggers a retry in background and duplicates the start event.

alana (DevEx): Repro (emulator, Android 11+): start chunked /v1/generate -> quickly call cancel() from UI (rotation or back press) -> server sometimes logs two session-starts.

diego (Android): Are we mixing call.cancel() with WorkManager/Background retry serialization? If the app cancels on the UI thread then a resumed background component might re-execute the same serialized Request object.

alana (DevEx): Exactly. Our Kotlin SDK serializes a small RetryJob that replays the Request via newCall(request).execute(). Java SDK used a buffered wrapper and disabled retries for streaming endpoints so it didn't replicate.

samir (Platform): Short-term mitigation ideas: (1) when contentLength==-1 or header Transfer-Encoding: chunked, mark request non-retryable; (2) make SDK default streaming client retryOnConnectionFailure(false); (3) ensure serialized retry jobs don't include unrepeatable bodies.

alana (DevEx): Proposed quick change: change RetryJob serializer to persist only URL+headers+idempotencyKey (no body) and fail fast if body is streaming. Pseudocode: 
```kotlin
if (req.body?.contentLength() == -1L) throw RetryNotAllowedException()
```

mia (QA): I can add a CI test: start sampleapp streaming request, trigger cancel (adb shell input keyevent 4) then wait 1s and assert server saw one start_token. Will run on Pixel 4/emulator matrix.

diego (Android): Also call out that newCall().execute() inside an interceptor is dangerous for one-shot bodies. We should avoid re-executing requests in interceptors; prefer OkHttp built-in behavior or clone() with buffered body.

samir (Platform): Long term: server-side dedupe by session-id or support an X-Idempotency-Key header. Client opt-in header can buy apps safe retries until we design server behavior.

alana (DevEx): I'll open a small PR with RetryJob guard and update the Android troubleshooting doc to explicitly warn against automatic retries for chunked endpoints. I'll also add a sampleapp regression test for cancel/rotation scenarios.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1910 - "Kotlin SDK background retry may duplicate streaming start after cancel/rotation"

mia (QA): thanks, adding the CI job now.

diego (Android): Thanks. I'll audit our interceptors for any re-execute patterns and replace with safer logic.
